BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY11-FY11 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.9%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.1-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.9%/yr (no FY11-FY11 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +6.9%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY11: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2012-02-10) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 59.00x (33.0% downside to Bear $30 / +0.6% upside to Bull $45) | Adj composite 1.25 vs market 3.93: gap -2.68 [OVERVALUED] | +71% above the EPP floor $26 (7x FY12E $3.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: -13.6% total (-6.8%/yr) | At 12.0x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $59 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas -26.5% and Intermediates & Derivatives -31.6% operating income in Q4 2011, forward revenues +7.9% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2011 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
